_comment: Copy this file to sql-config.json and fill in your WinRx SQL Server details. sql-config.json is git-ignored and must never be committed. The packaged app reads %AppData%\pharmacy-pos\sql-config.json first, which Settings -> WinRx & McKesson -> WinRx Connection writes for you — so you normally do not need this file at all; it is a convenience for running from source. Use the read-only login described in SQL-SETUP.md, never the sa account.
